P1.evidence: P1d ran — 'run me through it real quick. What were you hoping to get out of this conversation? Walk me through it' — and produced good material quickly. The other three did not run at all. No setter notes or application were read back, no four-part frame was set, and no frame agreement was taken. Scored partial rather than miss because the rep did explain the intended structure, though only as the justification for rescheduling: 'how we typically structure these conversations... I want to be able to go pretty in depth on where we're at, what we're looking for... we usually book off like a whole hour.' That is the frame arriving six minutes late and in service of ending the call. The mitigating point is real, though: he opened with light discovery, realised within six minutes that the setting made the process impossible, and stopped rather than compressing it.

P2.evidence: Unreachable. The call was terminated and rebooked before any baseline was attempted. Nothing is known about age, height, weight, health conditions, injuries, sleep or energy. The one adjacent fact that surfaced did so unprompted: he eats roughly one meal a day and his father believes it is harming him.

P3.evidence: Only one check was reachable and it landed well. P3d was asked plainly — 'What's the motivation to make some changes on this side of things, man? Out of curiosity for you' — and produced the single most useful thing in the file: the moment last August when he carried his four- and six-year-old upstairs and found himself winded, followed by the observation that he has them five days a week and could hardly manage it. That is a fully formed emotional driver obtained in under a minute, and it should be at the top of the notes for the rebooked call. Everything else in the phase was unreachable.

P4.evidence: One good question ran: 'What's motivating you to look for coaching now all of a sudden, because I mean, that's that was about a year ago, right when that happened?' — a well-aimed why-now that correctly picked up on the twelve-month gap between the trigger and the call. The answer was thin, mostly dietary planning and wanting new complexes, which is worth carrying into the rebooked call as an open thread. The rest of the phase was unreachable.

P5.evidence: Unreachable. No consequence frame was attempted and none should have been in a nine-minute call by a creek.

P6.evidence: Unreachable. No commitment check was attempted.

P11.evidence: No close was attempted and no price was mentioned, so the phase does not apply. The equivalent action for this call — securing a firm rebooking — was done properly: a specific time was agreed, the invite was updated live, and a confirmation touch was arranged with the setter.

notes: Scored almost entirely not applicable, and correctly so. The judgement call was right and is worth holding up as the standard: the rep recognised within six minutes that a prospect outdoors with two young children could not have the conversation the process requires, said so plainly, and rebooked with a specific time and a live calendar update rather than running a degraded version to get something on the board. Two things to carry forward. He should set the frame before discovery rather than six minutes in, even on a call he expects to be short. And the motivation material obtained here — the stairs moment, five years of sole custody, wanting to get back to himself — is unusually strong for nine minutes and should be read back at the top of Monday's call as P1a rather than re-elicited from scratch.
